recipes.title: Soft Caprese Fresh Basil, Tomato & Mozzarella Scramble
recipes.summary: Gentle fluffy scrambled eggs folded with sweet cherry tomatoes, pearls of fresh mozzarella, olive oil, and torn fragrant basil leaves.
steps: Warm olive oil over medium-low heat and soften halved cherry tomatoes 1 minute.
Pour in lightly beaten eggs and fold gently 2 to 3 minutes until soft curds form.
Turn off heat, fold in mozzarella pearls and torn fresh basil, and season with black pepper.
tips: Tearing fresh basil by hand instead of chopping prevents bruising and keeps the herb sweet and vivid green.
Moist, tender eggs pair nicely with warm whole-grain toast.

recipes.title: Whipped Ricotta, Strawberry & Fresh Basil Toast
recipes.summary: Whole-grain toast spread with cool creamy ricotta, sweet sliced strawberries, torn fresh basil ribbons, and a whisper of honey.
steps: Toast whole-grain bread until warm and crisp and spread evenly with ricotta.
Arrange sliced strawberries across both slices.
Snip fresh basil over top and finish with tiny drizzles of honey and extra-virgin olive oil.
tips: Sweet strawberries and garden basil are a classic Italian summer duo.
Use kitchen shears to snip basil cleanly with minimal wrist effort.

recipes.title: Fresh Basil Pesto & Avocado Soft-Poached Egg Bowl
recipes.summary: Soft poached egg and sliced ripe avocado served over warm baby spinach tossed with a quick 1-minute fresh basil and olive oil drizzle.
steps: Stir snipped fresh basil, extra-virgin olive oil, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt in a small bowl.
Toss baby spinach gently with half the basil oil and arrange in a shallow bowl with sliced avocado.
Nestle warm poached eggs on top and spoon the remaining fresh basil oil across.
tips: Snipped basil and olive oil delivers bright pesto aroma without dragging out a food processor.
Warm yolks blend right into the basil oil.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt, Ripe Peach & Sweet Fresh Basil Bowl
recipes.summary: Cool plain Greek yogurt layered with juicy diced peaches, toasted oats, honey, and delicate ribbons of fresh garden basil.
steps: Spoon plain Greek yogurt into a chilled bowl and top with diced ripe peach.
Scatter toasted rolled oats and lemon zest over the fruit.
Snip fresh basil ribbons right across the top and drizzle lightly with honey.
tips: Sweet basil's subtle floral clove note lifts ripe stone fruit wonderfully.
Thawed frozen peach slices work year-round.

recipes.title: Warm Tomato, Parmesan & Fresh Basil Savory Oatmeal
recipes.summary: Creamy broth-simmered rolled oats finished with sweet blistered cherry tomatoes, Parmesan, olive oil, and generous torn fresh basil.
steps: Simmer rolled oats and vegetable broth 5 minutes, then stir in halved cherry tomatoes and cook 2 more minutes until soft and creamy.
Remove from heat and stir in Parmesan cheese and extra-virgin olive oil.
Fold in abundant torn fresh basil so the steam releases its bright garden aroma and serve warm.
tips: Tastes like comforting tomato-basil risotto ready in under 10 minutes.
Top with a soft-boiled egg if you'd like extra protein.

recipes.title: Fresh Basil, Cannellini Bean & Tomato Caprese Bowl
recipes.summary: No-cook Italian lunch combining creamy cannellini beans, ripe tomatoes, fresh mozzarella, olive oil, balsamic glaze, and loads of fresh basil.
steps: Combine rinsed cannellini beans, halved cherry tomatoes, and fresh mozzarella pearls in a wide bowl.
Drizzle generously with extra-virgin olive oil and balsamic vinegar and season lightly with salt and pepper.
Fold in abundant torn fresh basil leaves right before serving.
tips: White beans make classic Caprese salad hearty and fiber-rich for a full midday meal.
Swap mozzarella for diced avocado for a creamy dairy-free bowl.

recipes.title: 15-Minute Fresh Basil & Fire-Roasted Tomato Bisque
recipes.summary: Silky, dairy-free tomato soup blended bright with a whole generous cup of fresh sweet basil leaves, olive oil, and garlic.
steps: Saute onion and garlic gently in 1 tbsp olive oil for 4 minutes until soft.
Pour in crushed tomatoes and vegetable broth and simmer 10 minutes.
Turn off heat, add 1 full cup fresh basil leaves and remaining 1 tbsp olive oil, and blend completely velvety smooth.
tips: Adding fresh basil off the heat right before blending preserves its sweet emerald aroma.
Smooth, gentle, and naturally plant-based.

recipes.title: Chilled Fresh Basil, Cucumber & Peanut Rice Noodle Bowl
recipes.summary: Refreshing Asian-inspired noodle bowl tossed with cool rice noodles, crisp cucumber, shredded carrot, light lime-peanut sauce, and generous fresh basil.

ingredient_details.item: fresh sweet or Thai basil leaves

steps: Whisk peanut butter, lime juice, soy sauce, and 3 tbsp warm water until silky and pourable.
Toss cooled rice noodles, cucumber, and shredded carrots with the peanut-lime sauce.
Fold in abundant torn fresh basil leaves and serve cool.
tips: Snip rice noodles briefly with kitchen shears before tossing for effortless fork eating.
Top with shelled edamame or shredded poached chicken for extra protein.

recipes.title: Quick Basil Pesto Poached Chicken & Quinoa Bowl
recipes.summary: Vibrant 5-ingredient fresh basil pesto tossed with fluffy quinoa, tender shredded chicken, baby spinach, and sweet cherry tomatoes.
steps: Pulse fresh basil leaves, walnuts, olive oil, lemon juice, and a pinch of salt into a bright green pesto.
Toss cooked quinoa and shredded poached chicken gently with the fresh basil pesto.
Divide into two bowls and crown with juicy halved cherry tomatoes.
tips: Lemon juice keeps homemade basil pesto bright green even if packed for lunch the next day.
Swap chicken for chickpeas for a quick plant-based version.

recipes.title: Hydrating Watermelon, Cucumber, Feta & Fresh Basil Salad
recipes.summary: Crisp, ultra-hydrating summer salad tossing sweet seedless watermelon cubes, cool cucumber, creamy feta, lime, olive oil, and torn fresh basil.
steps: Place chilled watermelon cubes and diced cucumber in a wide salad bowl.
Drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil and fresh lime juice and toss lightly.
Scatter crumbled feta and abundant torn fresh basil leaves across the top and serve chilled.
tips: High-water watermelon and cucumber boost afternoon hydration effortlessly.
Cantaloupe swaps in deliciously alongside basil and lime.

recipes.title: Fresh Basil Pesto-Crusted Baked Salmon & Green Beans
recipes.summary: Flaky oven-baked salmon fillets blanketed in homemade fresh basil-olive oil herb paste alongside sweet roasted cherry tomatoes and green beans.
steps: Heat oven to 400 F; mix finely chopped fresh basil, 1 1/2 tbsp olive oil, grated garlic, and lemon juice in a small bowl.
Toss green beans and cherry tomatoes with remaining oil on a parchment-lined sheet pan and nestle salmon fillets beside them.
Spoon half the basil paste over the salmon, bake 12 to 14 minutes until flaky, then dot the remaining uncooked basil paste on top.
tips: Saving half the fresh basil paste to spoon on after baking keeps the herb vibrant and garden-sweet.
Zero blender needed—just finely snip basil with kitchen shears.

recipes.title: Mild Thai-Inspired Ground Turkey & Sweet Basil Rice Bowl
recipes.summary: Fast savory skillet supper of lean ground turkey, diced bell pepper, garlic, soy-lime glaze, and two overflowing cups of fragrant fresh basil.

ingredient_details.item: packed fresh sweet or Thai basil leaves
warm cooked jasmine or brown rice

steps: Cook ground turkey and finely diced bell pepper in a lightly oiled skillet 6 to 7 minutes until cooked through and tender.
Stir in minced garlic, soy sauce, and 2 tbsp water for 1 minute.
Turn off the burner, fold in 2 full cups fresh basil leaves and lime juice until wilted bright green, and spoon over warm rice.
tips: All the fragrant magic of Thai basil stir-fry (pad kra pao) kept gentle and chile-free.
Fine ground turkey is quick to cook and effortless to eat over rice.

recipes.title: 15-Minute Sweet Cherry Tomato & Fresh Basil Rigatoni
recipes.summary: Tender short pasta coated in jammy burst cherry tomatoes, garlic, extra-virgin olive oil, Parmesan, and heaps of torn fresh sweet basil.
steps: Boil short pasta according to package directions, saving 1/3 cup starchy cooking water.
Meanwhile simmer halved cherry tomatoes, sliced garlic, and olive oil in a skillet 8 minutes until soft and jammy.
Toss hot pasta and splashes of pasta water into the sauce, remove from heat, and fold in Parmesan and 1 full cup fresh torn basil.
tips: Tossing fresh basil off-heat turns the whole kitchen fragrant like an Italian trattoria.
Stir in a cup of cooked white beans for extra plant protein.

recipes.title: One-Pan Garlic, Zucchini & Fresh Basil Skillet Chicken
recipes.summary: Moist chicken thighs braised lightly in lemon-garlic broth with tender zucchini coins and abundant ribbons of fresh sweet basil.
steps: Brown chicken thighs lightly in olive oil 3 minutes per side, then add minced garlic and chicken broth; cover and simmer 8 minutes.
Tuck zucchini slices around the chicken, cover, and cook 5 minutes until chicken hits 165 F and zucchini is fork-tender.
Remove from heat, stir in lemon juice and abundant torn fresh basil, and serve warm.
tips: Cooking chicken thighs with broth keeps every bite juicy and tender.
Spoon pan juices over soft polenta or mashed potatoes.

recipes.title: Soft Eggplant, Chickpea & Sweet Basil Tomato Stew
recipes.summary: Velvety Mediterranean vegetable stew simmering peeled diced eggplant, chickpeas, garlic, and crushed tomatoes, finished with fresh basil and olive oil.
equipment: Dutch oven or wide pot with lid
steps: Saute diced eggplant and onion in olive oil 6 minutes until softened, then stir in minced garlic 1 minute.
Add crushed tomatoes, rinsed chickpeas, and 1/2 cup water; cover and simmer 13 minutes until eggplant is melt-in-your-mouth tender.
Remove from heat, fold in 1 cup torn fresh basil, and ladle into warm bowls.
tips: Peeling eggplant before simmering guarantees an ultra-silky, easy-to-swallow plant-based stew.
Tastes even better reheated the following evening.

recipes.title: Sweet Strawberry, Fresh Basil & Greek Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.summary: Bright Italian-summer smoothie blending frozen strawberries, fragrant fresh basil leaves, Greek yogurt, milk, and honey.
steps: Pour milk, Greek yogurt, fresh basil leaves, frozen strawberries, and honey into a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until silky pink with delicate herbal fragrance.
Pour into a chilled glass and enjoy immediately.
tips: Start with 6 to 8 fresh sweet basil leaves for an uplifting, refreshing note that never tastes savory.
Oat milk and plant yogurt keep it completely dairy-free.

recipes.title: Golden Peach, Mango & Fresh Basil Smoothie
recipes.summary: Sunlit golden smoothie uniting frozen peaches, mango, fresh sweet basil leaves, oat milk, and a bright squeeze of lime.
steps: Add oat milk, fresh basil leaves, frozen peaches, frozen mango, and lime juice to a blender.
Blend 45 seconds until glowing yellow and ultra-smooth.
Serve cold right away.
tips: Sweet stone fruit and mango make fresh basil taste bright, tropical, and crisp.
Naturally dairy-free and requires zero added sweetener.

recipes.title: Wild Blueberry, Lemon & Fresh Basil Antioxidant Smoothie
recipes.summary: Vibrant purple smoothie pairing frozen blueberries, ripe banana, fresh basil, lemon juice, and creamy almond milk.
steps: Combine almond milk, fresh basil leaves, frozen blueberries, banana, and lemon juice in a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until smooth and deep violet.
Pour into a glass and sip chilled.
tips: Fresh lemon makes blueberry and sweet basil sparkle together.
Add 1 tbsp rolled oats if you want a thicker morning meal.

recipes.title: Crisp Pineapple, Baby Spinach & Fresh Basil Green Smoothie
recipes.summary: Zesty green refresher blending baby spinach, sweet frozen pineapple, fresh basil leaves, coconut water, and banana.
steps: Blend coconut water, baby spinach, and fresh basil leaves 20 seconds until completely liquefied.
Add frozen pineapple, banana, and lime juice and blend 35 seconds more until frothy.
Serve ice-cold immediately.
tips: Basil adds garden brightness that elevates everyday spinach-pineapple green smoothies.
Cold water works seamlessly if you don't keep coconut water on hand.

recipes.title: Tart Raspberry, Kefir & Fresh Basil Probiotic Smoothie
recipes.summary: Tangy ruby smoothie combining plain kefir, frozen raspberries, sweet fresh basil leaves, banana, and pure vanilla.
steps: Add plain kefir, fresh basil leaves, frozen raspberries, banana, and vanilla to a blender.
Blend 50 seconds until rosy, airy, and smooth.
Pour into a glass and enjoy chilled.
tips: Kefir gives gentle cultured probiotics and silky sipping consistency.
Strain briefly through a sieve if you prefer zero raspberry seeds.

recipes.title: Pressed Watermelon, Lime & Fresh Basil Agua Fresca
recipes.summary: Thirst-quenching ruby summer juice blending sweet watermelon, fresh sweet basil leaves, cold water, and lime, strained crystal smooth.
steps: Blend watermelon cubes, chilled water, fresh lime juice, and basil leaves for 20 seconds.
Pour through a fine-mesh strainer into a pitcher to remove pulp and leaf specks.
Serve cold over ice with an extra fresh basil leaf on top.
tips: Blending fresh basil briefly with juicy watermelon infuses every drop instantly without needing simple syrup.
Wonderfully hydrating on hot afternoons.

recipes.title: Garden Strawberry, Lemon & Fresh Basil Press
recipes.summary: Light, bright strawberry-basil lemonade made fresh in a blender with ripe berries, fresh lemon juice, sweet basil, honey, and chilled water.
steps: Blend hulled strawberries, fresh basil leaves, lemon juice, honey, and chilled water 25 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve into two ice-filled glasses for a clear, jewel-red drink.
Serve immediately.
tips: Far lower in sugar than cafe lemonades while bursting with fresh garden aroma.
Top with sparkling water for a festive afternoon spritzer.

recipes.title: Crisp Cucumber, Green Apple & Fresh Basil Spa Juice
recipes.summary: Clean emerald garden press blending cool cucumber, crisp apple, lemon juice, and fresh basil leaves, strained light and silky.

ingredient_details.item: unsweetened green or crisp apple juice

steps: Blend chopped cucumber, apple juice, chilled water, fresh basil leaves, and lemon juice 25 seconds.
Strain through a fine-mesh sieve, pressing gently with a spoon to extract every drop of bright green juice.
Pour over ice and enjoy crisp.
tips: No juicer needed—a regular blender plus strainer produces clean spa juice in minutes.
Cooling, crisp, and naturally low in sugar.

recipes.title: Sunny Orange, Pineapple & Fresh Basil Sparkling Press
recipes.summary: Uplifting citrus-tropical mocktail gently muddling fresh basil leaves with freshly squeezed orange juice, pineapple juice, and bubbly water.
steps: Lightly press fresh basil leaves against the bottom of a tall glass with a wooden spoon just until fragrant.
Fill with ice cubes and pour in freshly squeezed orange juice and pineapple juice.
Top with sparkling water, stir gently once, and sip right away.
tips: Pressing basil gently releases sweet essential oils without turning the leaves bitter.
Swap sparkling water for still cold water whenever you prefer.

recipes.title: Chilled Garden Tomato, Lemon & Fresh Basil Press
recipes.summary: Crisp savory vegetable juice blending low-sodium tomato juice, a handful of fresh basil leaves, fresh lemon, and cracked black pepper.
steps: Pulse chilled tomato juice, fresh basil leaves, lemon juice, olive oil, and black pepper in a blender for 15 seconds.
Strain through a fine sieve if you prefer a spotless crimson pour.
Serve chilled over two ice cubes.
tips: Tastes like chilled summer bruschetta in a crisp, refreshing glass.
Half a teaspoon of olive oil supports lycopene absorption cleanly.
